items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: go to Chicago, you know, when Sugar Ray fought Jake LaMotta or whoever he fought

ctx.x: Now in exchange for me doing that, what I did for him to help him, he gave me the band and he let me have the checkroom. Well, I was always all right with...these people were supposed to be underworld people, or gangsters, or whatever they were...I didn't know. But I always...I could get checkrooms. You know, so this is how I'm making a living.

God, I don't know how I'm making a living. I'm driving a big car, you know, checkrooms, see me eat in the better places with everybody; see me at the fight, ringside; go to Chicago, you know, when Sugar Ray fought Jake LaMotta or whoever he fought; here at Joe Louis', you know; go to the Polo Grounds, Madison Square Garden, then I knew everybody. And I knew everybody. Because of the fact that many of these people who I knew in the territories (and) in the various cities, if they were not living in New York,…
Once I almost had a meat company, you know. Down Home...
